# Project Governance

**Lichess-MakeChessBetter** is an independent open-source project founded, developed, and maintained solely by **Aarav Patel** (@GoogleHub67).

## 👑 Decision Making
As a solo project, all decisions regarding features, engine choices (Stockfish configurations), API integrations, and code merges are made exclusively by the project owner. 

## 🤝 Contributions
While community feedback and issue reports are welcome, code contributions via Pull Requests will be reviewed and merged at the sole discretion of the project owner to protect the bot's competitive integrity and stability.
